# README

Run make equivalent and see the result as vignette

```{r}
targets::tar_make()
browseURL("_output/vignettes/01_simple_brms.html")
```

## if you using quarto, remember to check if there any `_quarto.yml` a level above, interfering with your project


# Targets

Print the steps into the console
```{r}
tar_manifest(fields = command)
```

And visualise the analysis
```{r}
# scripts/build_graphs.R
library(targets)
library(htmlwidgets)

dir.create("docs", showWarnings = FALSE)
g <- tar_visnetwork(targets_only = TRUE,  label = c("description"),
  label_width = 50)        # interactive htmlwidget
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(g, "docs/pipeline.html", selfcontained = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# scripts/build_graphs.R
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(visNetwork)
library(htmlwidgets)

dir.create("docs", showWarnings = FALSE)

net <- targets::tar_network(targets_only = TRUE)  # nodes + edges
nodes <- net$vertices %>%
  transmute(
    id    = name,
    label = name,                                   # short, clean node text
    title = paste0("<b>", name, "</b><br/>", dplyr::coalesce(description, "")) # HTML tooltip
  )

edges <- net$edges %>%
  transmute(from = as.character(from), to = as.character(to))

g <- visNetwork(nodes, edges, height = "750px", width = "100%") %>%
  visHierarchicalLayout(direction = "LR", levelSeparation = 180, nodeSpacing = 120,
                        treeSpacing = 180, blockShifting = TRUE, edgeMinimization = TRUE,
                        sortMethod = "directed") %>%
  visNodes(shape = "box", widthConstraint = list(maximum = 240)) %>%
  visEdges(arrows = "to", smooth = FALSE) %>%
  visOptions(highlightNearest = list(enabled = TRUE, hover = TRUE), nodesIdSelection = TRUE) %>%
  visInteraction(hover = TRUE) %>%
  visPhysics(enabled = FALSE)

htmlwidgets::saveWidget(g, "docs/pipeline.html", selfcontained = TRUE)
```



```{r}
# scripts/pipeline_graph.R
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(visNetwork)
library(htmlwidgets)

# 1) Build the network from your pipeline
net <- targets::tar_network(targets_only = TRUE)

# 2) Nodes MUST have `id`; edges MUST have `from`/`to` matching those ids
nodes <- net$vertices %>%
  transmute(
    id    = name,                                 # <- crucial
    label = name,
    description = dplyr::coalesce(description, ""),
    title = paste0("<b>", name, "</b><br/>", description)  # HTML tooltip
  )

edges <- net$edges %>%
  transmute(
    from = as.character(from),   # ensure character and match `nodes$id`
    to   = as.character(to)
  )

# 3) Build widget (add arrows so direction is obvious)
g <- visNetwork(nodes, edges, height = "700px", width = "100%") %>%
  visEdges(arrows = "to") %>%
  visOptions(highlightNearest = TRUE) %>%
  visInteraction(hover = TRUE)

# 4) Save to HTML
dir.create("docs", showWarnings = FALSE)
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(g, "docs/pipeline_tooltips.html", selfcontained = TRUE)
```
